extensions.description: The settings of the commands that the binary adds. Each key is the name of an extension, and the kernel commands do not read the values.

ignore.description: The directive names that the load does not report as unclaimed. A name is a full directive name, or a plugin prefix that ends with a colon.

memo.description: The parse memo. It stores the regions of each unit that a run parsed.

dir.description: The directory of the memo entries. A relative path is relative to the workspace root. The default is the memo directory inside the state directory.

limit.description: The size of the memo in bytes. The value is a number, or a number followed by KiB, MiB or GiB. The memo is off when the limit is 0.

options.description: The option values of the plugins. Each key is the name of a plugin, and each nested key is the key of an option.

enabled.description: When false, the composition leaves the plan out, and the next run removes the files of the plan. The default is true.

layout.description: The policy, the output directory, the import base and the refinements of the generators of the plan. Each value that the file sets replaces the value of the plan.

dir.description: The output directory of the plan. The path is relative to the workspace root and uses slashes.
The output directory of the files of the generator. The path is relative to the workspace root and uses slashes.
The output directory of the files of the family. The path is relative to the workspace root and uses slashes.

file.description: The filename of every file of the family, in place of the filename that the target spells.

policy.description: The placement of the files of the family. The value is inherit, alongside-source or centralised.

families.description: The refinements of the routing of the families of the generator. Each key is the tag of a family, and the empty key names the primary family.

file.description: The filename of every file of the generator, in place of the filename that the target spells.

policy.description: The placement of the files of the generator. The value is inherit, alongside-source or centralised.

generators.description: The refinements of the routing of the generators of the plan. Each key is the name of a generator of the plan.

importBase.description: The import path of the output directory. A plan needs it when no loaded module contains the output directory.

policy.description: The default placement of a generated file. The value is inherit, alongside-source or centralised.

plugins.description: The directories of the declarative plugins that the plan runs after the generators of the binary. A directory is absolute or relative to the workspace root, and uses slashes. Build refuses plugins for a plan that the binary does not mark extensible.

policies.description: The choices of the lowering policies of the plan's backend. Each key is a policy key, such as typescript.int64, and each value is one of the choices of the key. A choice replaces the choice of the same key at the top level for the plan. Quote a choice that YAML reads as another type, such as "null".

sources.description: The source packages of the plan. They replace the sources that the plan declares.

lang.description: The source language of the packages, such as golang.

module.description: The module path of the packages.

packages.description: The package directories. A directory is relative to the workspace root and uses slashes. ./svc is one directory, and ./svc/... is that directory and every directory below it.

plans.description: The refinements of the plans of the binary. Each key is the name of a plan.

policies.description: The choices of the lowering policies. Each key is a policy key, such as typescript.int64, and each value is one of the choices of the key. A choice applies to every plan whose backend declares the key. Quote a choice that YAML reads as another type, such as "null".

version.description: The version of the file format. It must be 1.

workers.description: The number of matches that one phase call runs at the same time. With 0 or 1, a phase call runs one match at a time.

workspace.description: The name of the workspace. The default is the base name of the workspace root.

version.description: The version of the file format. It must be 1.

workspaces.description: The workspaces, in the order that a command runs them.

config.description: The config file of the workspace. A relative path is relative to the directory of the list. The default is the config file of the brand in the root.

root.description: The workspace root. A relative path is relative to the directory of the list.
